# hetznerrobot Provider

Manage [Hetzner Robot](https://robot.hetzner.com) — dedicated servers, IPs, subnets, failover IPs, reverse DNS, SSH keys, boot configurations, firewalls, vSwitches, Storage Boxes and orders — as code, through the [Robot webservice](https://robot.hetzner.com/doc/webservice/en.html).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hetznerrobot = {
      source = "kirchdev/hetznerrobot"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials of a Robot webservice user (Robot → Settings → Web service and
# app settings). They may also come from HETZNER_ROBOT_USER and
# HETZNER_ROBOT_PASSWORD.
provider "hetznerrobot" {
  username = var.robot_user
  password = var.robot_password
}

variable "robot_user" {
  type = string
}

variable "robot_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the webservice. Defaults to `https://robot-ws.your-server.de`. May also be set via `HETZNER_ROBOT_ENDPOINT`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the webservice user. May also be set via `HETZNER_ROBOT_PASSWORD`. Robot blocks the calling IP for ten minutes after three failed logins.
- `username` (String) Webservice user (Robot → Settings → Web service and app settings). May also be set via the `HETZNER_ROBOT_USER` environment variable.
